checks.text: The wholesaler sees their own offer and that it is waiting

shots.caption: The wholesaler sees only their own offer

notes: Only one wholesaler account exists in this copy, so a second bidder could not be set up to prove that bids are hidden from each other. The screen shows only the wholesaler's own offer.
did: Looked at the offer again after sending the bid, and read what the wholesaler sees about it.
